{"cmd":"python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, shutil, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path('data/orders')
snapshot = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='orders-before-', dir='/tmp'))
files = list(root.rglob('*.json'))
for path in files:
    original = path.read_bytes()
    dest = snapshot / path.relative_to(root)
    dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest.write_bytes(original)
    order = json.loads(original)
    if order.get('status') == 'paid':
        count = sum(item['qty'] for item in order['items'])
        assert 'itemCount' not in order
        end = original.rfind(b'}')
        assert end >= 0 and original[end-1:end] == b'\n'
        path.write_bytes(original[:end-1] + f',\n  "itemCount": {count}\n'.encode() + original[end:])
for path in files:
    before = (snapshot / path.relative_to(root)).read_bytes()
    after = path.read_bytes()
    old, new = json.loads(before), json.loads(after)
    if old.get('status') == 'paid':
        assert new.pop('itemCount') == sum(item['qty'] for item in old['items'])
        assert new == old
        assert after.decode() == json.dumps(json.loads(after), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n'
    else:
        assert before == after
print(f"Verified {len(files)} orders: {sum(json.loads((snapshot / p.relative_to(root)).read_bytes()).get('status') == 'paid' for p in files)} paid updated; all other files byte-identical.")
shutil.rmtree(snapshot)
